verification_rules: All metadata fetched live on the generated_at date from the Hugging Face Hub API (model info, cardData, and /tree/{revision} endpoints); no model weights were downloaded and no repository code was executed.

Network note: huggingface.co and cdn-lfs.huggingface.co are unreachable from the build sandbox (TLS connection reset). Identical official HF API data was read through hf-mirror.com, a full read-only mirror of the official HF API; every commit SHA, byte size and LFS sha256 is HF backend metadata, not mirror-generated. Official GitHub repos were checked via api.github.com.
repoId, default-revision commit SHA (API 'sha' field at fetch time), and gated status were verified per repo; every file entry lists the exact byte size from the pinned-revision tree API.
sha256 values are the LFS 'oid' published by the HF API (SHA-256 of file content); null where HF does not expose it (gated repos mask LFS oids for anonymous clients).
license taken from card metadata (cardData.license) and corroborated against LICENSE/NOTICE files in the repo or the publisher's official GitHub repo; licenseUrl points at the verified source.

remoteCodeRequired is true when the HF repo ships no runnable modeling code and external code (e.g. a GitHub package) or trust_remote_code is needed; verified via config.json (auto_map absent/present), library_name and model card.

minVramBytes is null unless an official source states an exact figure; minRamBytes is set only to the derivable hard floor (exact total weight bytes that must be mappable in RAM/VRAM) and never includes context, KV-cache or framework overhead.
sizeScope states explicitly whether sizeBytes is a single file or a complete required set; multi-file sets list every required file.
Anything whose existence, revision, license or size could not be verified exactly is excluded rather than guessed (see excluded[]).

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (GGUF Q4_K_M)
models.runtime: llama.cpp (and GGUF-compatible frontends: llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio)
models.hardwareNotes: 30B-total / 3B-active MoE (48 layers, 128 routed experts, 8 active), 262,144-token context. Single 17,988,419,552-byte (16.75 GiB) file; that size is the hard memory floor - add headroom for context/KV cache. Fits desktop machines with >=32 GB total RAM+VRAM.
caveats: Qwen does not publish an official GGUF for this model (candidate repo ID 'Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF' returns HF API 404); this is the ggml-org (official llama.cpp organization) conversion, automatically produced by https://github.com/ggml-org/convert.
Provenance verified: repo file .src_sha pins source Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct@b2cff646eb4bb1d68355c01b18ae02e7cf42d120, which matches the base model's current default revision at fetch time.
Alternative community quant unsloth/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF exists (Q4_K_M = 18,556,689,568 bytes, different bytes); not selected.
In this Q4_K_M the small non-expert tensors (embeddings, attention) are kept at Q8_0 (per publisher card).

models.name: Qwen3-8B (GGUF Q4_K_M)
models.runtime: llama.cpp (and GGUF-compatible frontends: llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio)
models.hardwareNotes: 8.2B-parameter dense model, 32,768-token native context (131,072 with YaRN). Single 5,027,783,488-byte (4.68 GiB) file is the memory floor; comfortable on desktops with >=8-16 GB RAM.
caveats: Official Qwen-published GGUF repo (base model Qwen/Qwen3-8B verified apache-2.0, non-gated).
Supports thinking/non-thinking mode switching; per card, recommended sampling temp=0.6, top-p=0.95, top-k=20, min-p=0, presence-penalty=1.5.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next (GGUF Q4_K_M)
models.sizeScope: complete-quantization-set (Q4_K_M is split into 4 GGUF shards; all 4 required)
models.runtime: llama.cpp, very recent build (hybrid Gated-DeltaNet 'qwen3-next' architecture; card: 'we follow the latest version of llama.cpp')
models.hardwareNotes: 80B-total / 3B-active hybrid MoE, 262,144-token native context. The 4-shard Q4_K_M set totals 48,410,992,032 bytes (45.09 GiB) - the memory floor; practical only on high-RAM desktops (>=64 GB RAM or equivalent unified memory/VRAM).
caveats: Included per task condition: metadata and exact byte sizes are fully verifiable from the official Qwen repo; hardware size is exact (48.41 GB set) but far above typical desktop GPU VRAM.

Neither the base repo nor this GGUF repo ships a LICENSE file and the card's license_link (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next/blob/main/LICENSE) is dead; apache-2.0 is declared in both repos' card metadata.
Card recommends --jinja -fa on -sm row and sampling temp=1.0, top-p=0.95, top-k=40; non-thinking model only.

models.name: Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning (Llama-3.1-FoundationAI-SecurityLLM-8B-Reasoning)
models.sizeScope: complete-required-set (4 safetensors weight shards + index + config + generation_config + tokenizer files; README/LICENSE/NOTICE excluded)
models.license: other: Meta Llama 3.1 Community License (base model) + Apache-2.0 (Cisco modifications) - see NOTICE.md
models.runtime: transformers >=4.51.3 (AutoModelForCausalLM), vLLM; standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture so llama.cpp-compatible after GGUF conversion
models.hardwareNotes: 8B dense Llama-3.1-architecture model in bf16; weight shards total 16,060,884,056 bytes (14.96 GiB) - the memory floor at full precision. Cybersecurity-specialized; card states it may underperform on general tasks.
caveats: HF license tag is 'other' because of the dual license: Meta Llama 3.1 Community License applies to the base model (has Acceptable Use Policy and a 700M-MAU restriction); Cisco's changes are Apache-2.0. Review NOTICE.md before redistribution.
config.json has no auto_map; no trust_remote_code needed. Verified non-gated (gated:false).
config.json enables fused kernels with flash_attn backend by default (_use_fused_kernels: true) - optional flash-attn dependency.
Intended for local deployment per card; out-of-scope uses include non-security tasks and autonomous security decisions without human oversight.

models.name: TripoSR
models.sizeScope: complete-required-set (model.ckpt weights + config.yaml; repo also contains demo videos not required for inference)
models.runtime: Official 'tsr' package from github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR (PyTorch); HF repo ships weights + config only
models.hardwareNotes: Single 1,677,246,742-byte (1.56 GiB) checkpoint is the memory floor; no official inference VRAM figure is published (card states only training hardware: 22 nodes x 8x A100 40GB). Publisher advertises <0.5 s generation on an NVIDIA A100.
caveats: Card YAML still contains stale 'extra_gated_fields', but the repo is NOT gated: HF API reports gated:false and an anonymous resolve request for model.ckpt returns HTTP 302 (public CDN redirect), verified on the generated_at date.
MIT license declared in card and corroborated by the official GitHub repo LICENSE (checked via GitHub API).
model.ckpt is a pickled PyTorch checkpoint (torch.load) - only load from this verified official repo.
Runtime also downloads facebook/dino-vitb16 (image tokenizer, per config.yaml) on first run.
Inference code is not in the HF repo; install the official GitHub codebase (do not execute unverified forks).

models.name: FLUX.1-schnell
models.sizeScope: complete-required-set (diffusers pipeline layout: model_index.json, scheduler, transformer/ 3 shards + index, text_encoder, text_encoder_2 2 shards + index, vae, tokenizers; excludes redundant single-file flux1-schnell.safetensors/ae.safetensors, README and preview image)
models.runtime: diffusers (FluxPipeline); single-file flux1-schnell.safetensors (23,782,506,688 bytes, also in repo) suits ComfyUI-style loaders
models.hardwareNotes: Diffusers-layout weight set totals 33,725,923,002 bytes (31.4 GiB): DiT transformer 23.78 GB (3 shards) + T5-XXL text_encoder_2 9.52 GB + CLIP text_encoder 0.25 GB + VAE 0.17 GB. No official min VRAM figure is published; diffusers supports fp16/offload but requirements vary - not derivable, hence null.
caveats: GATED repo (HF API gated:'auto'): anonymous download is impossible; the user must log in with a Hugging Face account and accept the auto-approved access terms (extra_gated_description present in card). This is the reason for medium confidence - access restriction, not metadata uncertainty.
HF masks LFS sha256 oids for gated repos to anonymous clients, so per-file sha256 is null; byte sizes ARE verified from the pinned-revision tree API.

Apache-2.0 license is declared in official card metadata and corroborated by the publisher's official GitHub repo black-forest-labs/flux LICENSE (Apache-2.0, verified via GitHub API); the gated README/LICENSE could not be read anonymously.

Repo also contains single-file flux1-schnell.safetensors (23,782,506,688 bytes) and ae.safetensors (335,304,388 bytes) as an alternative non-diffusers layout; they are excluded from sizeBytes to avoid double-counting the same weights.

models.name: TRELLIS.2-4B
models.sizeScope: complete-required-set for this repo (14 safetensors checkpoints + their JSON configs + pipeline.json + texturing_pipeline.json; README/.gitattributes excluded). NOTE: pipeline.json additionally references one checkpoint from microsoft/TRELLIS-image-large - see caveats.
models.runtime: Official 'trellis2' Python package from github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS.2 (PyTorch + custom CUDA extensions compiled against CUDA toolkit, 12.4 recommended)
models.hardwareNotes: OFFICIAL card statement: 'An NVIDIA GPU with at least 24GB of memory is necessary' (encoded as 24 x 10^9 bytes; 24 GiB = 25,769,803,776 bytes). Linux only ('currently tested only on Linux'); verified by publisher on A100/H100. CUDA toolkit needed to compile packages; Conda + Python >=3.8 recommended. H100 inference: ~3 s at 512^3, ~17 s at 1024^3, ~60 s at 1536^3.
caveats: pipeline.json references an external checkpoint NOT in this repo: microsoft/TRELLIS-image-large/ckpts/ss_dec_conv3d_16l8_fp16.safetensors (147,591,972 bytes, verified via HF API) - required by the default image-to-3D pipeline.
Runtime also downloads facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m (image conditioning) and briaai/RMBG-2.0 (background removal) per pipeline.json.

HF repo ships weights + pipeline configs only (library_name: trellis2); the pipeline class lives in the official GitHub repo and requires compiling native extensions - heaviest install in this catalog; Windows/macOS not officially supported.
MIT license declared in card and corroborated by official GitHub repo LICENSE (verified via GitHub API).
Pre-trained foundation model without alignment (per card).

excluded.reason: Repository does not exist: HF API returns 404 'Repository not found' (verified on the generated_at date). Qwen publishes no official GGUF for this model. Substituted in models[] with the ggml-org (official llama.cpp org) conversion ggml-org/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF, whose provenance (.src_sha) pins the current base-model revision.

Valid and popular (Q4_K_M = 18,556,689,568 bytes, apache-2.0, revision b17cb02dd882d5b6ab62fc777ad2995f19668350 verified) but not selected: ggml-org is the official llama.cpp organization with pinned source provenance, preferred for a verified catalog.
